title: Quick Feet
notes: Beginner plyometrics from Ted Ryce's thread (twitter-thread.com/t/2100563272713846966): explosive power declines faster than strength with age. Thread prescribes 1-2 sets of 30 sec for every drill; 2 sets are loaded here, drop the second if needed. Rest periods are not in the thread (60 sec is a placeholder). Technique is shown in the thread's videos.

exercises.name: Plate Plyometric
exercises.notes: Thread: 1-2 x 30 sec. Coordination, reactive strength, reintroduces quick ground contacts.

exercises.name: Lateral Plate Plyometric
exercises.notes: Thread: 1-2 x 30 sec. Side-to-side movement, lateral power, reactive strength.

exercises.name: Alternating Plate Pogo
exercises.notes: Thread: 1-2 x 30 sec. Independent foot use, rhythm, single-leg reactive strength.

exercises.name: Plate Jump Switch
exercises.notes: Thread: 1-2 x 30 sec. Foot speed, reactive strength, lower-body coordination.

exercises.name: Plate Toe Taps
exercises.notes: Thread: 1-2 x 30 sec. Quick ground contacts, single-leg reactive strength.
